5/5 will recommend. My friend often eats dinner, so I went to try it, I have lunch at 12 o'clock. Clean restaurant, friendly staff, the music is a bit jarring and unpleasant. The dishes have generally been adjusted to suit Vietnamese tastes, from easy to eat to tastier than most burger joints I've tried in both Saigon and Hanoi. I'll order two portions of chicken and beef burgers. The chicken was processed quite quickly, but my cow has to wait almost 20 minutes ^^
